decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

- (CHA) 42-01
- REHAU Total 70 spec with glazing bars
- Allan bros � Sliding Sash Window spec
- Solar Panel Specification � DMEGC Infinity RT

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Front elevation windows: Double-glazed, timber-framed sliding sash windows with integrated sash horns and glazing bars to match existing (white finish).

- Rear/side elevation windows: Double-glazed, Rehau heritage uPVC frames with glazing bars (white finish).

- Front door: door to match existing (universal composite doors).

- Rear door: uPVC door to match existing.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC6 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).


Condition : 4 - Where the existing windows to be replaced are obscure glazed and/or fixed shut they shall be replaced with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and where relevant shall be non-opening and fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level. The windows shall thereafter be permanently retained in this form.

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - The photovoltaic panels hereby approved shall not be situated anywhere other than the location as shown in drawings hereby approved and the panels shall be permanently maintained in accordance with this requirement. At no point shall additional panels be installed unless permission is first granted by the council.    

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to prevent harm to the street scene, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018)
Condition : 6 - The solar/renewable equipment hereby approved shall, when they are no longer required for renewable energy purposes, be removed from the building and the building restored to its condition before the development took place.

In order to ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC8 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Installation of 6no. photovoltaic solar panels to the front roof slope; replacement of all existing single glazed timber framed windows to the front elevation with new double glazed timber framed windows; replacement of existing traditional moulded door and single glazed top light window to the front elevation with a traditional moulded door and double glazed top light window; and replacement of all existing single glazed timber framed windows to the rear and side elevations with new double glazed uPVC framed windows.
